claims.claim: promptarena validate and promptarena export use packc/compiler
compiler.Check stages and order; early stages stop, later collect
arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
prompt config requires task_type, version, description, system_template; task_type pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$; version semver
variable name pattern ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ with required field, metadata.language ^[a-z]{2}$, tool name pattern
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before loading with [pack_id] error; invalid --pack-version likewise
default id from current directory name normalized; 'My Project' becomes my-project, '2024-demo' becomes pack-2024-demo

skill checks: missing dir, path outside, SKILL.md parse, duplicate names, inline fields, workflow state skills path; allowed-tools warning; relative to config dir (compile) or pack dir (validate); @org/name resolves to the install dir and errors only when not installed
workflow errors/warnings: version 1|2, entry, prompt_task, targets, enums, composition, PascalCase, cycles, terminal, v2 dead-end, agent loops
agents errors: no members, entry not member, member not prompt; MIME/tag findings are warnings
packc compile, compile-prompt and validate all run the composition check via checkPack
governance check: undeclared eval/validator/field/obligation errors, undeclared prefix warning
pack structure checks id, semver version, prompts, template_engine, system_template, prompt version, variables-declared are blocking; missing compilation and undeclared prompt tools are warnings
schema failures print as '[pack_schema] <path>: <msg>' under '✗ Pack validation failed: <file>'; schema-load failure is a pack_schema error
packc validate parses JSON ([load] invalid JSON) then runs schema, then pack checks; compile runs schema last
validation uses the embedded PromptPack schema by default; PROMPTKIT_SCHEMA_SOURCE remote/path overrides
embedded PromptPack schema is version 1.9.0 (identical to promptpack-spec schema)
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'; only errors printed on failure
templates are not parsed; only check is variables declared when template contains {{
promptarena validate also runs an assertions stage that checks assertion types and params and prompt validator params, when the config has scenarios, personas, evals or prompt validators
